items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: I've played with him. I've never called myself a member of, uh, no band but Lewisty Man.

ctx.x: The theater. Yeah, yeah. Uh, what instrument did you play all those bands with, uh, those? Still playing it? I played with, uh, still playing it.
Still playing it? I played with, uh, with Amos Riley. But, you know, when I started playing with Lewisty Man, I had my B Tenor. The B Tenor. Yeah. When did you take up the bass?
